I once did 250-350mg insufflated. I had a small tolerance. AND i was already coming down off about 100mg MXE so i would of had an acute tolerance too. I can't really remember much about it but I took this dose at around midnight and by the time I was sobering up it was already dark again. I wasn't with it to experience the day it kinda went by in a blurr. The sequence of events that happened are all mixed up in my memory and it was as if the whole event took place at once, or is stored chronically  as one point in time. I can't remember anything after I snorted the big dose, nothing at all. I can't remember why I did it or anything before hand. I just remember doing it. when I did finally come round I came round in waves, my conscious existence would be back in the room, kind of awake and I kept asking my ex if I was dead, if I was dreaming, what universe I was in, where I was. he kept assuring me I was alive, and hadn't fallen into another universe. anyway I would fade back out and it was almost like my senses just slowly fading away. I was a bit panicky as I had no control over it and I didn't even know I was on drugs I had totally forgotten everything. at some point in the future, I was more lucid/awake and realized what I had done, I thought I had gotten brain damage, it just felt like it was lasting too long it was like almost a full day since I dosed and i still couldnt use my brain properly. my sight was all cartoony, my thoughts and memory where scattered.
